name: Tsukishima Kouichirou
source:
Star Sign: Cancer
Special Skill/Hobby: Piano
Favorite Food: Cold Yam Soba
Disliked Food: Sweets

The CUE commanding officer.
A smart, cool, and collected guy who is well trusted by his subordinates.
He's always put together nicely in order to look good for the press.
He's friends with his coworker Enami.
